resolution: Fixed the duplicated-whole-list / ghost-row Assets tree ('bad react' — correct call). Three fixes in ab03a73a5: (1) ContentTreeNode wraps its expanded children in a dedicated HW_TreeChildren container so the keyed row array never sits bare beside the Row (documented reconciler array-sibling hazard; also keeps big expanded trees under the per-container child cap); (2) AppFrame holds the last tree shape while modelRenamingId is active so name-sorting can't re-rank keyed rows per keystroke, rebuilding once on rename finish; (3) the rename-follow package-directory move (a full every-blob copy) no longer rides each keystroke — updateManifestIdentity defers it and finishRenameModel settles it once via settleRenamedPackageDir. esbuild-verified all four touched files; hot reload picks it up.
